meta.name: ai-product-photography
meta.description: Generate professional AI product photography and commercial images. Models: FLUX, Imagen 3, Grok, Seedream for product shots, lifestyle images, mockups. Capabilities: studio lighting, lifestyle scenes, packaging, e-commerce photos. Use for: e-commerce, Amazon listings, Shopify, marketing, advertising, mockups. Triggers: product photography, product shot, commercial photography, e-commerce images, amazon product photo, shopify images, product mockup, studio product shot, lifestyle product image, advertising photo, packshot, product render, product image ai

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成专业产品摄影与电商营销图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为电商或广告制作专业商品图但缺少影棚设备
copy.tagline_en: Generate professional product photos and commercial visuals for e-commerce and ads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need professional product photos for e-commerce or ads without a studio

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 infsh 命令行调用 FLUX、Imagen 3 等模型,按你的描述生成产品摄影图。它内置白底、生活方式、英雄镜头、平铺、使用中等多种风格,以及电子、时尚、美妆等品类模板,还能批量出图,并串联放大和去背景后处理。
howto.when: 当你说出 "product photography"、"product shot" 等触发词,或要求生成电商、亚马逊等平台的产品图、广告宣传照时触发。

say.text: 给这款无线耳机生成一张白底商品图,柔和影室灯光,电商风
say.note: 会调用 FLUX 生成白底商品图。

say.text: 把这张产品图放大两倍,并去掉背景,存成透明底 PNG
用 Imagen 3 生成一张口红在白色背景上的美妆广告照

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude uses the infsh CLI to generate product photos via FLUX, Imagen 3, etc. It covers white-background, lifestyle, hero, flat-lay, and in-use shots, plus category templates, batch runs, and upscaling/background removal.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention trigger words like 'product photography' or 'product shot', or ask for e-commerce/Amazon product images or ad photos.

say_en.text: Upscale this product image 2x, remove the background, and export as transparent PNG
Use Imagen 3 to generate a beauty ad shot of a lipstick on white background
